# Introduction

</div>



## Authentication[​](#authentication "Direct link to heading"){.hash-link} 



[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)]{.admonitionIcon_kALy}info



Please visit Bybit\'s [**testnet**](https://testnet.bybit.com/app/user/api-management){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} or [**mainnet**](https://www.bybit.com/app/user/api-management){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} to generate an API key



REST API Base Endpoint:

-   **Testnet:**\
    [https://api-testnet.bybit.com](https://api-testnet.bybit.com){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}
-   **Mainnet**(both endpoints are available):\
    [https://api.bybit.com](https://api.bybit.com){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}\
    [https://api.bytick.com](https://api.bytick.com){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}



[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)]{.admonitionIcon_kALy}info



-   All requests made to **private** endpoints MUST be authenticated.



### Select Your API Key Type[​](#select-your-api-key-type "Direct link to heading"){.hash-link} 

-   **System-generated API Keys**: The API key generated by the Bybit system operates with HMAC encryption. You will be provided with a pair of public and private keys. Please treat this pair of keys as passwords and keep them safe.

    > Follow [HMAC sample scripts](https://github.com/bybit-exchange/api-usage-examples){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} to complete encryption procedures.

-   **Auto-generated API Keys**: Self-generated API keys operate with RSA encryption. You must create your public and private keys through the software, and then only provide the public key to Bybit, we will never hold your private key.

    > 1.Use [api-rsa-generator](https://github.com/bybit-exchange/api-rsa-generator){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} to create RSA private and public key\
    > 2.Follow [RSA sample scripts](https://github.com/bybit-exchange/api-usage-examples){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} to complete encryption procedures.

### Parameters for Authenticated Endpoints[​](#parameters-for-authenticated-endpoints "Direct link to heading"){.hash-link} 

The following parameters must be used for authentication:

-   `X-BAPI-API-KEY` - api key
-   `X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP` - UTC timestamp in milliseconds
-   `X-BAPI-SIGN` - a signature derived from the request\'s parameters
-   `X-Referer` or `Referer` - the header for broker users only\

We also provide `X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW` (unit in millisecond and default value is 5,000) to specify how long an HTTP request is valid. It is also used to prevent replay attacks.

A smaller `X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW` is more secure, but your request may fail if the transmission time is greater than your `X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW`.



[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)]{.admonitionIcon_kALy}caution



Please make sure that the timestamp parameter adheres to the **following rule**:\
*server_time - recv_window \<= timestamp \< server_time + 1000*



### Create A Request[​](#create-a-request "Direct link to heading"){.hash-link} 



[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)]{.admonitionIcon_kALy}info



Example signature algorithms can be found [here](https://github.com/bybit-exchange/api-usage-examples){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}



**Basic steps:**

1.  timestamp + api-key + (recv_window) + (queryString \| jsonBodyString)\
2.  Use the **HMAC_SHA256** or **RSA_SHA256** algorithm to sign the string in step 1, and convert it to a hex string (HMAC_SHA256) / base64 (RSA_SHA256) to obtain the sign parameter.\
3.  Append the `sign` parameter to request header, and send the HTTP request. **Note:** the plain text for **GET** and **POST** requests is different. Please refer to blew examples.

> An example for how to generate plain text to encrypt


-   GET
-   POST





``` {.prism-code .language-shell .codeBlock_bY9V .thin-scrollbar tabindex="0"}
# rule:
timestamp+api_key+recv_window+queryString

# param_str
"1658384314791XXXXXXXXXX5000category=option&symbol=BTC-29JUL22-25000-C"

# parse
timestamp = "1658384314791"
api_key = "XXXXXXXXXX"
recv_window = "5000"
queryString = "category=option&symbol=BTC-29JUL22-25000-C"
```


[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0iY29weUJ1dHRvbkljb25feTk3TiIgdmlld2JveD0iMCAwIDI0IDI0Ij48cGF0aCBkPSJNMTksMjFIOFY3SDE5TTE5LDVIOEEyLDIgMCAwLDAgNiw3VjIxQTIsMiAwIDAsMCA4LDIzSDE5QTIsMiAwIDAsMCAyMSwyMVY3QTIsMiAwIDAsMCAxOSw1TTE2LDFINEEyLDIgMCAwLDAgMiwzVjE3SDRWM0gxNlYxWiIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.copyButtonIcon_y97N}![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0iY29weUJ1dHRvblN1Y2Nlc3NJY29uX0xqZFMiIHZpZXdib3g9IjAgMCAyNCAyNCI+PHBhdGggZD0iTTIxLDdMOSwxOUwzLjUsMTMuNUw0LjkxLDEyLjA5TDksMTYuMTdMMTkuNTksNS41OUwyMSw3WiIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.copyButtonSuccessIcon_LjdS}]{.copyButtonIcons_eSgA aria-hidden="true"}








``` {.prism-code .language-shell .codeBlock_bY9V .thin-scrollbar tabindex="0"}
# rule:
timestamp+api_key+recv_window+raw_request_body

# param_str
1658385579423XXXXXXXXXX5000{
    "category": "linear"
}

# parse
timestamp = 1658385579423
api_key = XXXXXXXXXX
recv_window = 5000
raw_request_body = {"category": "linear"}
```


[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0iY29weUJ1dHRvbkljb25feTk3TiIgdmlld2JveD0iMCAwIDI0IDI0Ij48cGF0aCBkPSJNMTksMjFIOFY3SDE5TTE5LDVIOEEyLDIgMCAwLDAgNiw3VjIxQTIsMiAwIDAsMCA4LDIzSDE5QTIsMiAwIDAsMCAyMSwyMVY3QTIsMiAwIDAsMCAxOSw1TTE2LDFINEEyLDIgMCAwLDAgMiwzVjE3SDRWM0gxNlYxWiIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.copyButtonIcon_y97N}![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0iY29weUJ1dHRvblN1Y2Nlc3NJY29uX0xqZFMiIHZpZXdib3g9IjAgMCAyNCAyNCI+PHBhdGggZD0iTTIxLDdMOSwxOUwzLjUsMTMuNUw0LjkxLDEyLjA5TDksMTYuMTdMMTkuNTksNS41OUwyMSw3WiIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.copyButtonSuccessIcon_LjdS}]{.copyButtonIcons_eSgA aria-hidden="true"}







> http request examples


-   http-get
-   http-post





``` {.prism-code .language-http .codeBlock_bY9V .thin-scrollbar tabindex="0"}
GET /unified/v3/private/order/list?category=option&symbol=BTC-29JUL22-25000-C HTTP/1.1
Host: api-testnet.bybit.com
-H 'X-BAPI-SIGN: XXXXXXXXXX' \
-H 'X-BAPI-API-KEY: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' \
-H 'X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP: 1658384431891' \
-H 'X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW: 5000'
-H 'cdn-request-id: test-001'
```


[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0iY29weUJ1dHRvbkljb25feTk3TiIgdmlld2JveD0iMCAwIDI0IDI0Ij48cGF0aCBkPSJNMTksMjFIOFY3SDE5TTE5LDVIOEEyLDIgMCAwLDAgNiw3VjIxQTIsMiAwIDAsMCA4LDIzSDE5QTIsMiAwIDAsMCAyMSwyMVY3QTIsMiAwIDAsMCAxOSw1TTE2LDFINEEyLDIgMCAwLDAgMiwzVjE3SDRWM0gxNlYxWiIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.copyButtonIcon_y97N}![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0iY29weUJ1dHRvblN1Y2Nlc3NJY29uX0xqZFMiIHZpZXdib3g9IjAgMCAyNCAyNCI+PHBhdGggZD0iTTIxLDdMOSwxOUwzLjUsMTMuNUw0LjkxLDEyLjA5TDksMTYuMTdMMTkuNTksNS41OUwyMSw3WiIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.copyButtonSuccessIcon_LjdS}]{.copyButtonIcons_eSgA aria-hidden="true"}








``` {.prism-code .language-http .codeBlock_bY9V .thin-scrollbar tabindex="0"}
POST /unified/v3/private/order/cancel-all HTTP/1.1
Host: api-testnet.bybit.com
-H 'X-Referer: XXXXXXXXXX' \ [the header for broker users only]
-H 'X-BAPI-SIGN: XXXXXXXXXX' \
-H 'X-BAPI-API-KEY: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' \
-H 'X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP: 1658385589135' \
-H 'X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW: 5000' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
-H 'cdn-request-id: test-002'
-d '{
"category": "option"
}'
```

## Common response parameters[​](#common-response-parameters "Direct link to heading"){.hash-link} 

### Derivatives[​](#derivatives "Direct link to heading"){.hash-link} 

  Parameter    Type     Comments
  ------------ -------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  retCode      number   Success/Error code
  retMsg       string   Success/Error msg. Can be `OK`,`success`,`Success` for Success message
  result       Object   Business data result
  retExtInfo   Object   Extend info. Most of time, it is `{}`
  time         number   Current timestamp (ms)

}
